errors.text_span: This bar chart illustrates the token ratio for several language models, comparing RedWhale to other models including EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-SN, KoBEST-BQ, and KoBEST-HS.
errors.evidence: The description fundamentally misunderstands the chart. It is a grouped bar chart comparing three models (RedWhale, EEVE-Korean, SOLAR) across six evaluation categories (PT-EVAL, the KoBEST set, and AVG). The description incorrectly lists the evaluation categories on the x-axis as if they were additional models being compared.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the model names, presented in alphabetical order,
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis displays evaluation categories (e.g., PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ), not model names. The models are indicated by the color-coded bars in the legend. The categories are not in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: the vertical axis represents the token ratio, ranging from 0.42 to 0.79, with values marked at regular intervals, such as 0.52, 0.56, 0.58, 0.69, 0.74, 0.79, and 0.86
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the range of the vertical axis; the maximum value shown is 1.00, not 0.79. It also misinterprets the data labels on top of the bars as axis tick marks ('values marked at regular intervals').
The values 0.79 and 0.86 do not appear anywhere in the chart. The value 0.79 appears to be a misreading of the OCR for the value 0.74, and 0.86 is completely fabricated.

errors.text_span: Each bar corresponds to a specific model and is colored blue;
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart, with three bars per category. The description fails to mention this structure and incorrectly states all bars are blue, ignoring the gray bars for the 'SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0' model.

errors.text_span: the RedWhale bar has a value of approximately 0.59, resulting in the tallest bar in the visualization.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. RedWhale is represented by multiple bars with different values (0.42, 0.52, 0.71, 0.50, 0.69, 0.57). None of them are 0.59, and they are not the tallest bars; the gray bars for the SOLAR model are the tallest at 1.00.
All bars corresponding to the SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 model have a value of 1.00, not 0.78.

errors.text_span: The KoBEST models – KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-SN, KoBEST-BQ, and KoBEST-HS – each have token ratios of approximately 0.58, 0.69, 0.69, and 0.74 respectively,
errors.evidence: The KoBEST items are evaluation categories on the x-axis, not models. Each category has three bars with three different values. Assigning a single, incorrect value to each category is a fundamental misinterpretation of the chart.

errors.text_span: the average is represented by a bar with a token ratio of approximately 0.59.
errors.evidence: The 'AVG' category on the x-axis is not a single bar. It is a group of three bars representing the average performance of the three models, with values 0.57, 0.61, and 1.00. The value 0.59 is incorrect.
The description fails to mention the legend, which is essential for understanding which color corresponds to which model (RedWhale, EEVE-Korean, or SOLAR).
